Subject: Publicity language & logo use — Order Form Qs

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the update on the Order Form. A couple of quick questions from our comms/legal teams before we sign:

1) Can Redwood include ClearSky in a customer announcement / press release? Our legal team needs a short, narrow carve-out in the MSA so we can approve any public mention quickly. Ideally: approval within 3 business days and right to review copy.

2) If we grant logo usage for marketing materials, we want to limit display to non-confidential promotional pages only and require adherence to our logo guidance (colors/clearspace). Can Redwood confirm how logo files will be used and stored?

We attached a short list of requirements from our legal team and the draft order form redline. Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,
Sarah Nguyen

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2024 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed redlines — publicity & logo use (DL-4892)

Team — drafted suggested redline and commentary below. I'm keeping the language narrow to align with ClearSky's ask. Paste into order form:

"Publicity and Use of Customer Name and Trademarks. Customer grants Redwood the non-exclusive, royalty-free right to identify Customer as a customer of Redwood Inference in case studies and marketing materials; provided, however, Redwood shall (i) provide Customer with the proposed press release or marketing copy at least three (3) business days prior to publication, and (ii) not publish any materials including Customer's name, logo or trademarks without Customer's prior written approval, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld. Use of Customer's logo by Redwood shall be in accordance with Customer's logo guidelines and limited to promotional, non-confidential marketing materials. All logo files will be stored in Redwood's asset control system; access will be limited to marketing and partner teams and will be logged for audit purposes."

Comments:
- Keeps a clear 3-business-day review period.
- Adds a reasonable "not unreasonably withheld" standard to avoid vetoes for ordinary marketing.
- Adds a short operational note on storage and logging to address ClearSky's evidence request.

If Mateo/Monica are aligned I can insert this into the order form PDF and send to Sarah/legal for review. Recommend we also attach Redwood_Logo_Guidelines.pdf to show how we'll display logos (size/clearspace/color).

— Kim
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
